input.clock: receive time, matching accepted backtest tape; no forward-filled buckets

definitions.close_to_close: up/down relative to preceding close; prior/current bars must be valid
definitions.gap_safe: Any bucket overlapping any recorded gap interval is excluded; points exclude containing bucket. This conservatively includes receipt-silence and trade-ID-gap candidates, not all proven loss.
definitions.average: Fully observed same-color runs ending directly in opposite color; flats separate; first/last runs touching capture/gap bounds censored.
definitions.last_two: All overlapping last-two-color opportunities, including inside longer runs; next flat kept in denominator.
definitions.exact_two: Two-color run immediately preceded by opposite color; only all-four-valid windows.
definitions.limits: Single previously examined day. Frequencies are descriptive, not calibrated prospective probabilities; overlapping opportunities and serial/regime dependence remain.
